page: Microsoft Azure E16-8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered for memory-intensive workloads that require constrained core counts, typically for database licensing efficiency. Powered by the AMD EPYC 9V45 processor on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores operating at up to 4.5 GHz. The configuration provides 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high ratio of 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage includes 945 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for remote Premium Storage, with no integrated hardware accelerators.

Benchmark data demonstrates exceptional single-core processing capabilities alongside standard multi-core throughput. The instance achieves top-tier results in single-thread stress-ng benchmarks and a Geekbench single-core score of 2,774.0, complemented by top-tier single-threaded compression and decompression rates. In contrast, multi-threaded metrics such as the PassMark CPU score of 19,052.76, Geekbench multi-core score of 10,407.0, and Redis SET throughput of 14.99 million operations per second settle into the middle tier, reflecting the constrained 8-vCPU footprint. Cached memory read throughput reaches 878.94 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write bandwidth register at 50.01 GB/sec and 34.09 GB/sec, respectively.

The hardware configuration provides substantial cost efficiency for enterprise software licensed per core, such as relational databases, by concentrating large memory allocations and fast single-thread throughput onto fewer execution threads. The bundled NVMe SSD supplies rapid local temporary storage without additional disk provision overhead, though persistence requires attached storage volumes. The primary operational tradeoff stems from the limited core count, making this instance less suitable for horizontally scalable parallel processing or large-scale AI model execution.

Microsoft Azure E16-8ads_v7 is well suited for relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, in-memory data caches, memory-bound analytical jobs, and intermediate ETL staging requiring fast local scratch disks.
description: Microsoft Azure E16-8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocking up to 4.5 GHz. Configured with 128.0 GB of RAM and 945 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage, it offers an expansive 16 GB of memory per vCPU. Single-core performance is top tier, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core rating of 2,774.0 and strong compression benchmarks. Multi-core performance aligns with the middle tier due to the constrained core count, yielding 10,407.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 14.99 million operations per second in Redis tests. By bundling substantial memory and fast local NVMe storage onto a reduced core allocation, this instance optimizes licensing costs for memory-intensive enterprise database engines, in-memory caches, and transactional applications.
